nextReadySlice.title: Manifest machine-readable schema validation
failingProof: A failing proof shows the approved manifest envelope and hosted inspection fixtures are not yet validated against one machine-readable schema artifact, so malformed-but-shape-compatible JSON can still escape direct schema checks.
A failing proof shows the hosted JSON and markdown inspection fixtures are not yet pinned to the same schema contract as GeneratedManifestEnvelope roundtripping.
nextReadySlice.reviewGate: Stop for review before wider runtime or CLI manifest projections if the schema artifact needs new versioning rules, reveals envelope/fixture drift, or forces a new tooling contract.
